info.name: FluxStore Auth API - Complete
info.description: Comprehensive Postman collection for FluxStore Authentication API (v1). Every endpoint includes all possible response examples derived from validators, command handlers, and the IdentityService.

item.description: User registration endpoints. Calls CreateUserAndAuthenticateAsync then creates a domain User.

Triggers Identity weak-password error (Identity_WeakPassword__Password → 400).
Attempts change password without a Bearer token. The [Authorize] attribute rejects the request → 401.

item.description: Change password endpoints. Requires authentication. Calls ChangePasswordAsync which delegates to ASP.NET Identity ChangePasswordAsync.

item.description: Forget password flow. Calls GenerateResetPasswordOTP which checks user existence, lockout, and OTP cooldown, then sends an email.
